scoring_justification: T1 recompute for packing state (coordination number), voronoi densities (mean), percolation threshold, and conductivity exponents; structural checks for mechanical transition and conductivity curve shape where recompute of full curve comparison is not needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reproduction targets for generated random packing: average coordination number, rigidity transition density, mean Voronoi density, percolation threshold, conductivity exponents n_l and n_u.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values: coordination number 6.02 (text), rigidity threshold density ~0.603 (Figure 2), Voronoi mean density 0.610 (text), percolation threshold 0.335 ± 0.004, conductivity exponents n_l=0.68, n_u=1.69 (Section 'Effective conductivity').
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper text; these are the paper's own numbers for the computer-generated packing.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published results of the simulation experiment; the reference solve.sh writes artifacts consistent with them.

required.particles: array of {id: int, x: float, y: float, z: float, radius: float}

outputs.description: Final packing particle coordinates, radii, and contact list. The hidden checker recomputes coordination number distribution statistics from this artifact.

Compaction evolution: bulk modulus, coordination number, and maximum interpenetration as functions of relative density. The hidden checker compares reported values at selected densities with paper reference values.
Local relative density for each particle from Voronoi tessellation. The checker recomputes mean and standard deviation of the distribution from these values.
Single number: the site percolation threshold (critical site fraction). Checker compares it to a hidden reference value within a tolerance.
Effective conductivity vs. conducting site fraction. The checker verifies shape, sufficient data points, and uses them for internal consistency checks (refitting exponents).
Fitted percolation scaling exponents and the percolation threshold used. The checker compares n_l and n_u against hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker recomputes key statistics from the raw packing state and Voronoi densities, compares mechanical properties and percolation threshold against hidden reference values, and refits conductivity exponents for internal consistency. All tolerances are chosen to accommodate legitimate run-to-run variation due to random seed, discretisation, and implementation differences.

steps.description: Recompute average coordination number from contact list
Audit rigidity threshold: check sharp increase in bulk modulus around density 0.603
Compute mean local Voronoi density and compare to gold
Validate structure of conductivity data (row count, vf range, monotonicity)
Compare fitted exponents n_l and n_u against paper gold
